status: build complete; NOT accepted, no board access
purpose: Measure L at a second frequency so the split between design-clock cycles and fixed PS/DDR time can be solved rather than bracketed. Two-point EMPIRICAL model; linearity is an assumption to be tested, not asserted -- CDC quantisation, DDR scheduling and a changed implementation may all violate it.

intended_delta.derivation: 125 MHz oscillator on pin H16 x RC_CLK_MULT(8.0) / RC_CLK_DIVIDE

timing.note: read off THIS build's own report. An earlier prediction of +15.8 ns was a linear extrapolation from the 40 MHz build's WNS and was wrong by 2.4 ns; timing does not scale that way. No claim is made here about whether 50 MHz is reachable.

accepted_bitstream_for_contrast.note: the 40 MHz accepted bitstream. E1's is a DIFFERENT configuration identity and is not accepted.

model.caution: Linearity is the ASSUMPTION being tested, not a result. CDC quantisation, DDR controller scheduling and a changed implementation (re-synthesis moves placement and routing) can each violate it. Two points cannot detect curvature; they can only reject the two extreme hypotheses.
model.metrics_required: cross-frequency ratios reported in BOTH cycles and ns, as explicit experiment metrics; existing comparison guards stay enabled

not_done: restoration plan execution (needs two coordinated cold cycles)
